newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil '96 alcohol fuel car sales plunge 81.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil '96 alcohol fuel car sales plunge 81.2 pct.

text.p: Brazil alcohol fuel car sales plunged 81.2 percent to 7,647 from the 40,707 vehicles sold in 1995, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association Anfavea said.
Alcohol fuel car sales accounted for only 0.5 percent of total domestic sales in 1996, it said.
Between January and November Brazil produced 8,737 alcohol fuel vehicles, or 0.6 percent of total cars produced, Anfavea said.
Production and sales of alcohol fuel cars have been falling since the late 1980s, when government enthusiasm for the pro-alcohol campaign began to wane, resulting in fuel supply problems.
